rows.quote: To identify genetic instruments for plasma protein levels, we used the results of genome-wide protein quantitative trait locus (pQTL) mapping for 2,922 unique proteins performed by the UKB-PPP consortium.15 These analyses were restricted to the subset of the UKB-PPP who were of EUR ancestry and selected at random from the UKB (n = 34,557) rather than on the basis of phenotype (as previously described15).
rows.coder_note: Sentence states the pQTL mapping used was restricted to the European-ancestry randomly selected subset with exact n = 34,557, a conjunction matching one candidate row only; platform and year are not in the sentence.
